row.title: SEED-LIFECYCLE-1: seeds are judged by computed stage, never by claim
row.body: Every seed under instances/ (and every seeded repo) is built, deployed, verified live and answers 13 one-year survival classes before it counts as done; seedlife --check fails a false claim and seedlife --run keeps one Q-SEED item per seed.
